## Purpose

The goal of this page to utilize Tableau public feature on a topical subject, which is housing in the Europe.

Housing shortage in the Europe is becoming an acute problem with no end in sight. This below visualization is not supposed provide an in depth analysis. Rather to apply baseline reliable data with Tableau as leading BI solution.
The topic selection is only to underline the imporantance of the topic.

# The Reading

As per Edward Tufte a good dashboard should include grapics, tables and text commentary.
The combination of the three helps users taking away the best information out of the data.
The data table with absolute values is always is there to help to users to establish the facts. With that the reader is always able to validate, calculate for themselves. 

The derived visualizations like indexed linecharts and the year over year approach should communicate different aspect of the same things.
Despite the opening picture, apparently the Netherlands is having similar new year buildings in the past 10 years.
Certain countries on the perifery of Europe trend better and improving their output.
Although this data is lacking internal and external migration, population data, living trends and regional differences to paint a more realistic picture.

Ideally one dashboard should focus on aspect of the subject in question, if the reporting is well established. 
In case the user's goals are exploratory, then it is handy to place different views in the same dashboard and let the users analyze the data themselves. The crossfiltering legends are a big help in that regard.
